"use client";

import { List } from '@mantine/core';

function Demo() {
  return (
    <List listStyleType="disc">
      <List.Item>
        Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit, sed do eiusmod tempor incididunt ut
        labore et dolore magna aliqua. Ut enim ad minim veniam, quis nostrud exercitation
      </List.Item>
      <List.Item>First order item</List.Item>
      <List.Item>
        First order item with list
        <List withPadding listStyleType="disc">
          <List.Item>Nested item</List.Item>
          <List.Item>Nested item</List.Item>
          <List.Item>
            Nested item with list
            <List withPadding listStyleType="disc">
              <List.Item>Even more nested</List.Item>
              <List.Item>Even more nested</List.Item>
            </List>
          </List.Item>
          <List.Item>Nested item</List.Item>
        </List>
      </List.Item>
      <List.Item>First order item</List.Item>
    </List>
  );
}
const RendynExampleComponent = Demo;
export function RendynExample() { return <RendynExampleComponent  />; }

# Mantine list

6 published Mantine list examples with complete pinned source and MIT attribution.

## Installation

- Complete MIT usage examples extracted from the upstream demo code template; documentation configurator machinery is excluded.
- Mount MantineProvider once at your client application root and import @mantine/core/styles.css. The returned preview wrapper is a standalone example; reuse an existing provider when integrating.

- Copy every returned file and preserve the MIT licence notice.
- Render the returned preview.tsx example, or integrate the example into your existing provider.
